At five miles, Eric Gebbett was placed 6th with Len and Eric Bishop 28th and 43 rd respectively. Our fourth man at this stage was Alan Bishop in 55th place but he didn't stay there for long, and at nine miles was overtaken by Geoff Pearson.

In spite of being fairly new to marathon running both Leonard and Eric Bishop ran very confidently to finish 5th and 8th respectively. Bob Plummer,by gaining 11th place,completed our scoring team which was beaten by T.V.H. by the narrow margin of two points.

On a rather warm day, and in a field of close on one hundred starters, Eric Gebbett performed very well to finish in 8th place with a time of 1h.25m.18s. He was well backed up by Eric Bishop in 13th place and Bob Plummer 16th. In the team race we just pipped Mitcham for third place.

Walker was 12th with 24.24, Len Bishop 17th in 24.57 and Eric Bishop 26.02. Jim Heathfield took over from Collis on the second stage for the 'D' team with Bhatia running for the 'A', Shippen for the 'C' and Conway for the 'E'.
Eric Bishop had a most uncomfortable last lap owing to stomach trouble and dropped five places, however, the team result wasn't affected and the Bishop brothers were still our first three men home.

Our first man home was Eric Bishop, with brothers Alan and Len in 109th and 125th positions. Eric was followed in by Jim Heathfield, who is finding it very difficult to do any serious training now that he has changed his job.
